lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the pectoral fin; spots are organized into approximately 5-6 visible vertical columns in the mid-body section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, particularly evident in the mid-lateral region forming a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to a darker shadow region immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots visible on the anterior and mid-sections of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Two small, elongated high-luminance objects (commensal organisms) are visible adjacent to the ventral margin of the pectoral fin.
